title: Kitchen Diplomacy
style: world jazz, female lead vocal, kora and brass blend, mid-tempo 88 BPM, call and response, multilingual pickleball anthem, uplifting, longer than 2 mins
lyrics:
[INTRO - kora pluck, soft brass]
(spoken)
The kitchen line is the same in every country.
No power. Only touch.

[VERSE 1 - English]
Step up to the kitchen line
Soft shot, short flight
Keep it in the non-volley zone
Win the point with touch, not tone

[VERSE 2 - Mandarin transliteration]
Zou jin chu fang xian
Qing qing da, di di fei
Liu zai bu jie ji qu
Yong chu gan ying, bu yong li

[VERSE 3 - Hindi transliteration]
Kitchen line ke paas aao
Dheere maaro, neeche rakho
Non-volley zone mein raho
Taakat nahin, sparsh se jeeto

[CHORUS]
KITCHEN - CUISINE - COCINA - KUCHNIA
SOFT HANDS WIN THE WAR
HOLD THE LINE - SOFT AND SURE

[VERSE 4 - Greek transliteration]
Pliasase ti grammi kouzinas
Apalo htipima, hamili ptisi
Meine sti zoni mi-bole
Kerdise me afi, ohi dynami

[VERSE 5 - Polish]
Podejdz do linii kuchennej
Delikatny strzal, niski lot
ZostaN w strefie non-volley
Wygraj dotykiem, nie sila

[VERSE 6 - Yoruba transliteration]
Sunmo ila ibi idana
Lu rele, fo kekere
Wa ni agbegbe ti ko si fo
Bori pelu ifowokkan, kii se agbara

[CHORUS]
KITCHEN - CUISINE - COCINA - KUCHNIA
SOFT HANDS WIN THE WAR
HOLD THE LINE - SOFT AND SURE

[BRIDGE - spoken]
(coach voice)
Every culture. Every continent.
At the kitchen line, patience wins.
Soft. Short. Controlled.
Kitchen diplomacy.

[FINAL CHORUS]
KITCHEN - CUISINE - COCINA - KUCHNIA
SOFT HANDS WIN THE WAR
HOLD THE LINE - SOFT AND SURE
EVERY LANGUAGE - ONE TRUTH
SOFT HANDS WIN THE WAR

[OUTRO - kora solo, fade]
One kitchen. Every language.
Diplomacy wins.
